output.summary: The claim can be appealed by providing the required bariatric-surgery records and citing the appropriate coverage clause. The genetic-testing precedent is irrelevant to this case.

items.text: Collect the BMI record and supervised weight‑loss program record as required by the bariatric surgery coverage clause.
Submit an appeal citing clause C-2026-BARIATRIC (section 7.4) and attaching the collected records.
The genetic‑testing precedent (F‑GENETIC) does not apply because the denial concerns bariatric surgery, not a genetic test, and the governing clause is unrelated (C‑2026‑GENETIC‑TEST).
